Copper Camp v2

The richest hill on earth, 1906
Looking north from the Flat toward the Butte Hill. Big Butte on the left, Granite Mountain on the right.
Your ledger
Version 2 — a different game for each job, crew scenes, a walkable town with interiors. A survival game set in real places on the Butte Hill: the Anaconda, Mountain Con, Speculator, Leonard and Orphan Girl mines; the M&M, Hennessy's, the Miners' Union Hall, Mercury Street, Columbia Gardens, Finntown, Dublin Gulch, Meaderville, Centerville and China Alley. The historical events are real. The Copper Kings — Vance, Brandt and Hobart — and their detectives, clerks, gunmen and fixers are invented, loosely in the shape of the men who actually fought over the hill; the other people you meet, apart from public figures of the period, are invented too.
